description: A second vague-echo decline on a different set of memories. The reader asks about their brother. The records are about family dinners, a friend and a novel about sisters, so they sit near the subject without being about it. The honest answer is that nothing matches.

input.cue: Have I written anything before about my brother?

tool_evidence.excerpt: Sunday dinners at my parents' have got louder since everyone started bringing partners.
My oldest friend moved abroad and I keep drafting messages I never send.
Reading about the two sisters in that novel made me think about how differently people grow up in the same house.
